interface.longDescription: Organization-specific operational workflow skills for the Puppet cross-repo release lifecycle (module init, release, control-repo merge requests, fleet deploy), Hiera data debugging, and Ansible automation. Shipped as sanitized templates — substitute placeholders (puppet master host, environment names, ticket prefixes) with your own environment's values, which belong in your project CLAUDE.md, not in the skill.
